checks: Offline catalogue exposes both synthetic workflows, known answers and available exact 0.4.0 dependency pins beside align 0.4.1.
alignment-qc: editable exact-pin graph executes through native tools with known synthetic alignment truth and hash-bound result measurements.
variant-calling: editable exact-pin graph executes through native tools with known synthetic alignment truth and hash-bound result measurements.
Result search filters recorded names case-insensitively, explicit sample and tool metadata; an unmatched query returns no records.
A deliberately changed result file is reported unavailable and contributes no trusted metrics; restoring its original bytes restores the summary.
A fresh private application process restores both results and reconstructs the same scientific summaries from persisted evidence.
Missing align 0.4.0 disables both curated workflows with exact-version guidance and preserves the draft; installed align 0.4.1 is never substituted.
An explicitly selected missing read path fails preparation, retains its actual cause and submitted analysis name, and supplies actionable input guidance without scientific metrics or a QC verdict.
Native curated window lists both workflows, shows exact pins and synthetic expected answers, and loads an editable workflow.
A fresh native desktop finds the named failed preparation and displays its recorded missing-file error, failed execution state and explicit corrective input guidance.
Native results search selects the recorded variant run, renders sample/tool versions and scientific metrics, and disables View for an empty result set.
limits: Small bundled synthetic inputs and exact pack pins; no clinical accuracy, biological dataset or capacity claim.
Metrics are recorded measurements with explicit source identities, not inferred sample QC pass/fail.
Private scientific hosts deny Python socket operations; this is not operating-system firewall isolation.
Hosted display DPI only; physical trackpad, high DPI, multi-monitor and institutional acceptance remain separate.
